workflows: Brief -> generate draft (image/copy/blog) -> human review -> Browser Session publish checklist -> log outcome
Inbound comment triage -> Community Manager drafts -> CEO approve if required -> reply
Weekly ops rollup: pipeline counts + blockers -> notify CEO
channels: Connect Browser Session and log into Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and your blog CMS in Client Chrome.
Optional: Replicate BYOK under API Keys only if you want still-image generation beyond default tools.
Use Policies for public-post and comment-approval rules.
YouTube long-form / animated video packs are a separate industry (not this blueprint).

sop_documents.title: SOP - Content review before publish
sop_documents.contentText:
# Content review before publish

1. Media Generator produces draft (copy + optional image).
2. Content Reviewer checks brand_voice and Policies.
3. If style is approval, notify CEO and wait on Kanban.
4. Channel Publisher only runs publish checklist after review.
5. Log outcome on content_pipeline.

Scope: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, blogs. Not YouTube production.

sop_documents.title: SOP - Comment handling
sop_documents.contentText:
# Comment handling (FB / IG / LI / blog)

1. Community Manager drafts using comment_playbook.
2. Never invent facts; master_data_rag for product truth.
3. Escalate (notify_ceo) when escalate=yes or tone is hostile/legal.
4. Live posting uses Browser Session; do not claim native API publish unless configured.

sop_documents.title: SOP - Channel publish checklist
sop_documents.contentText:
# Publish checklist per channel

**All platforms**
- Asset reviewed and approved
- Caption length and hashtags OK
- No secrets / PII leaks

**Instagram** - Aspect ratio, carousel order, first comment if used
**LinkedIn** - Professional framing, no over-hashtagging
**Facebook** - Link preview check
**Blog CMS** - Title, slug, meta description, featured image

Prefer Browser Session recipes after login once.

Out of scope: YouTube long-form / animated video industry packs.

sop_documents.title: SOP - Weekly social ops summary
sop_documents.contentText:
# Weekly social ops summary
Ops Reporter every week:
1. Count content_pipeline by stage
2. Note blockers (accounts not connected, missing keys)
3. Summarize CEO approvals pending
4. notify_ceo with short rollup + links to Knowledge / Kanban

## Management style: AI suggests
- Drafts only; CEO decides.
- Prefer notify_ceo for handoffs.
policy_templates.after_approval:
## Management style: AI executes after approval
- Prepare full drafts; public actions need CEO approval via Kanban or chat.
- Internal research may run without approval.
policy_templates.autonomous:
## Management style: AI executes autonomously
- Execute within tool grants and budgets.
- Escalate legal/PR risk before acting.
